model_annotation: The diagram shows the employment rate of women with a migration background. The x-axis is labeled "Alter" (age) and ranges from 20 to 70, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10, representing age in years. The y-axis is labeled "Anteil Erwerbstätiger in %" (share of employed people in percent) and ranges from 0 to 100, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20, representing percentages. The diagram displays three lines: a black line representing women without a migration background, a gray line representing women who immigrated to Germany up to 2009, and a light blue line representing women who immigrated to Germany from 2010 onwards. The black line starts at approximately 80% at age 20, peaks at around 90% between ages 30-40, and declines to around 50% at age 70. The gray line starts at around 60% at age 20, increases to approximately 80% between ages 30-40, and then declines to around 40% at age 70. The light blue line starts at approximately 40% at age 20, increases to around 60% between ages 30-40, and then declines to around 30% at age 70.
